```{r setup, include=FALSE, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# library(rstudioapi)
# setwd('/Users/arielfogel/Epistemic Analytics/tma')
# Select the directory containing the tma script, like the directory above^
# setwd(selectDirectory())
devtools::load_all(".")
d = read.csv(system.file(package = "tma", 'extdata/test_data.csv'), stringsAsFactors = FALSE);
```

```{r toy_data_step_2, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
my.hoo.TMA = list()
my.hoo.TMA[[1]] = list(Condition = "<UNIT>", GroupName = "<UNIT>", Context = "Public")  
my.hoo.TMA[[2]] = list(Condition = "<UNIT>", UserName = "<UNIT>")
my.units = unique(d[,c("Condition", "UserName")])
codes = c('A','B','C')
modal.decay.function = list()
modal.decay.function$Private = step_function(window_size = 2);
modal.decay.function$Public = step_function(window_size = 2);
accumulation_window_2 = tma(
  data = d,
  units = my.units,
  codes = codes,
  hoo.rules = my.hoo.TMA,
  weight.by = function(x) {return(x)},
  return.ena.set = TRUE,
  time.column = NA,
  decay.function = modal.decay.function,
  mode.column = 'Context',
  time.limit = NA,
  # mask = NA,
  meta.data = c('Condition')
)
```
```{r directed_check_step_2, echo=TRUE}
User1_directed = t(matrix(c(
  0,0,1,
  0,0,0,
  0,0,0
),3,3))
colnames(User1_directed) = rownames(User1_directed) = c('A','B','C')
assertthat::are_equal(
  User1_directed, accumulation_window_2$contexts$`FirstGame::User1`$directed.adjacency
)

User2_directed = t(matrix(c(
  0,0,0,
  0,0,0.5,
  0,1.5,0
),3,3))
colnames(User2_directed) = rownames(User2_directed) = c('A','B','C')
assertthat::are_equal(
  User2_directed, accumulation_window_2$contexts$`FirstGame::User2`$directed.adjacency
)

User3_directed = t(matrix(c(
  0,0,0.5,
  2,0,1,
  1.5,0,0
),3,3))
colnames(User3_directed) = rownames(User3_directed) = c('A','B','C')
assertthat::are_equal(
  User3_directed, accumulation_window_2$contexts$`FirstGame::User3`$directed.adjacency
)
```

```{r toy_data_continuous_decay_use_time_column, echo=FALSE}
# d = read.csv('test_data/test_data.csv');
d$time = convert.time( as.character(d$Timestamp), units = "minutes");
my.hoo.TMA = list()
my.hoo.TMA[[1]] = list(Condition = "<UNIT>", GroupName = "<UNIT>", Context = "Public")  
my.hoo.TMA[[2]] = list(Condition = "<UNIT>", UserName = "<UNIT>")
my.units = unique(d[,c("Condition", "UserName")])
codes = c('A','B','C')
modal.decay.function = list()
modal.decay.function$Private = continuous.decay.function.over.ten.minutes;
modal.decay.function$Public = continuous.decay.function.over.ten.minutes;
accumulation_with_time_column = tma(
  data = d,
  units = my.units,
  codes = codes,
  hoo.rules = my.hoo.TMA,
  weight.by = function(x) {return(x*1)},
  return.ena.set = TRUE,
  time.column = 'time',
  decay.function = modal.decay.function,
  mode.column = 'Context',
  time.limit = 7,
  # mask = NA,
  meta.data = c('Condition')
)
```
```{r directed_continuous_decay_use_time_column_test, echo=TRUE}
User1_directed = t(matrix(c(
  0,0,1,

  0,0,.5
),3,3))
colnames(User1_directed) = rownames(User1_directed) = c('A','B','C')

  User1_directed, accumulation_with_time_column$contexts$`FirstGame::User1`$directed.adjacency
)

User2_directed = t(matrix(c(

)
```

```{r toy_data_continuous_decay_with_empty_rows, echo=FALSE}
d = read.csv(system.file(package = "tma", 'extdata/toy_dataset_with_empty_rows.csv'), stringsAsFactors = FALSE);
d$time = convert.time( as.character(d$Timestamp), units = "minutes");
my.hoo.TMA = list()

codes = c('A','B','C')
modal.decay.function = list()
modal.decay.function$Private = continuous.decay.function.over.ten.minutes;
modal.decay.function$Public = continuous.decay.function.over.ten.minutes;
accumulation_with_time_column = tma(
  data = d,
  units = my.units,
  codes = codes,
  hoo.rules = my.hoo.TMA,
  weight.by = function(x) {return(x*1)},
  return.ena.set = TRUE,
  time.column = 'time',
  decay.function = modal.decay.function,
  mode.column = 'Context',

)
```
